class.name: VehicleDrivetrain3D
class.brief_description: Engine, gearbox and final drive for a [VehicleBody3D].
class.description: VehicleDrivetrain3D replaces the single [member VehicleBody3D.engine_force] value with a drivetrain. Add it as a child of a [VehicleBody3D] (or point [member vehicle] to one) and set [member throttle] every frame. The node works out the engine speed from the speed of the car, evaluates the engine torque from [member torque_curve] and [member peak_torque], multiplies it by the current gear and [member final_drive], and sets the [member VehicleWheel3D.engine_force] of the wheels with [member VehicleWheel3D.use_as_traction]. An open differential splits the torque evenly between the driven wheels that touch the ground. The result behaves like a real car: strong acceleration in low gears, a rev limiter that stops the car from accelerating beyond what the current gear allows, no drive while the clutch is open during a gear change, engine braking when the throttle is released, and reverse that can only be engaged when the car has nearly stopped. With [member automatic] the gearbox shifts up at [member shift_up_rpm] and down at [member shift_down_rpm], never selecting a gear that would immediately shift back, and waits [member shift_hold] seconds between automatic shifts so it does not hunt. [codeblock] func _physics_process(delta): $VehicleDrivetrain3D.throttle = Input.get_action_strength("accelerate") $VehicleDrivetrain3D.reverse = Input.is_action_pressed("reverse") $VehicleBody3D.brake = Input.get_action_strength("brake") * 20.0 $VehicleBody3D.steering = Input.get_axis("steer_right", "steer_left") * 0.5 [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] The torque is converted to a force with each wheel's radius, so set [member VehicleWheel3D.wheel_radius] correctly. Because the engine speed comes from the ground speed in the direction the car faces, a car that is sliding sideways has a low engine speed.

method.name: get_engine_rpm
method.description: Returns the current engine speed in revolutions per minute.

method.name: get_engine_torque
method.description: Returns the torque of the engine in the last physics frame, in newton-meters.

method.name: get_gear
method.description: Returns the current gear: [code]1[/code] and up are forward gears, [code]0[/code] is neutral and [code]-1[/code] is reverse.

method.name: get_wheel_torque
method.description: Returns the total torque sent to the driven wheels in the last physics frame, in newton-meters. It is negative when driving backward or when engine braking slows a car moving forward.

method.name: is_shifting
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a gear change is in progress and no torque is transmitted.

method.name: set_gear
method.description: Selects a gear directly, for a manual gearbox. [code]-1[/code] is reverse, [code]0[/code] neutral. Starts a gear change and emits [signal gear_changed].

method.name: shift_down
method.description: Selects the next lower gear, down to reverse.

method.name: shift_up
method.description: Selects the next higher gear, up to the last one.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the gearbox chooses forward gears. Turn it off and use [method shift_up] and [method shift_down] for a manual gearbox.
Fraction of the engine torque that reaches the wheels, between [code]0[/code] and [code]1[/code].
Torque at [member max_rpm] that slows the car when the throttle is released. It scales with the engine speed.
Ratio of the final drive, multiplied with the ratio of every gear.
Ratio of each forward gear, from first gear up. Larger ratios give more wheel torque and a lower top speed.
Engine speed at which the torque is evaluated while the clutch slips at a standstill. Without it the car would have almost no torque when starting at idle speed.
Engine speed of the rev limiter. Above it no torque is delivered.
Torque in newton-meters at the best point of [member torque_curve].
If [code]true[/code], reverse is engaged as soon as the car has nearly stopped; otherwise it returns to first gear.
Engine speed below which the automatic gearbox shifts down.
Minimum time between two automatic gear changes.
Duration of a gear change. The clutch is open and no torque flows during it.
Engine speed above which the automatic gearbox shifts up.
The position of the accelerator pedal, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code]. Set it every frame.

Torque multiplier by engine speed. The curve is sampled from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code] of [member max_rpm] on the x axis and its y value multiplies [member peak_torque]. If not set, a built-in curve that peaks in the middle of the range is used.
The [VehicleBody3D] to drive. If empty, the parent node is used.

signal.name: gear_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the gear changes, by the automatic gearbox, [method set_gear], or because reverse was selected or released.
